text.description_html:
Emtek S86002, Modern Stainless Steel Baden Door Handle

The Stainless Steel Baden 8 Inch Pull has a Brushed Stainless Finish that makes this modern handle as durable as it is eye-catching. The Modern Stainless Steel Baden Door Handle has an 8 inch center to center length and an 8-5/8 inch overall length. It will fit doors up to 1-3/4 inches thick. The Baden Pull comes with everything you'll need to thru-bolt mount it on your wood, metal, or fiberglass door.

Thru-Bolted Mounting: Pull bolts through the door.

Also Available: Stainless Steel Baden Pull with Back-to-Back Mounting

Specifications of the Emtek Stainless Steel Baden Solid Brass Pull:

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Total Length: 8-5/8"
  • Center to Center Length: 8"
  • Pull Handle Width: 1-1/16"
  • Total Projection: 2-1/8"
  • Base: 1" x 1/16"
  • Door Thickness: for doors up to 1-3/4" thick
  • Includes installation hardware required for fiberglass, wood, and metal doors.
  • Comes packaged with (2) 1" long 1/4"-20 screws, (2) 1" long #10-32 screws, (2) 2" #10-32 screws, and (2) screw caps.

Sold individually with thru-bolt mounting.
